module

public import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Erdős Problem 208
*Reference:* [erdosproblems.com/208](https://www.erdosproblems.com/208)
-/

@[expose] public section

open Filter Real

namespace Erdos208

/-- The sequence of squarefree numbers, denoted by `s` as in Erdős problem 208. -/
noncomputable def erdos208.s : ℕ → ℕ := Nat.nth Squarefree

open erdos208

/--
Let $s_1 < s_2 < \dots$ be the sequence of squarefree numbers. Is it true that
for any $\epsilon > 0$ and large $n$, $s_{n+1} - s_n \ll_\epsilon s_n^\epsilon$?
-/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem erdos_208.parts.i : answer(sorry) ↔
    ∀ ε > (0 : ℝ), (fun n => (s (n + 1) - s n : ℝ)) =O[atTop] (fun n => (s n : ℝ)^ε) := by sorry

/--
Let $s_1 < s_2 < \dots$ be the sequence of squarefree numbers. Is it true that
$s_{n + 1} - s_n \le (1 + o(1)) \cdot (\pi^2 / 6) \cdot \log (s_n) / \log (\log (s_n))$?
-/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem erdos_208.parts.ii : answer(sorry) ↔ ∃ (c : ℕ → ℝ), (c =o[atTop] (1 : ℕ → ℝ)) ∧ ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      s (n + 1) - s n ≤ (1 + (c n)) * (π^2 / 6) * log (s n) / log (log (s n)) := by
  sorry

/--
In [Er79] Erdős says perhaps $s_{n+1} - s_n \ll \log s_n$, but he is 'very doubtful'.

[Er79] Erdős, Paul, __Some unconventional problems in number theory__. Math. Mag. (1979), 67-70.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem erdos_208.variants.log_bound :
    (fun n ↦ (s (n + 1) - s n : ℝ)) =O[atTop] fun n ↦ log (s n) := by sorry

end Erdos208

reformulations.difference: The 1979 paper uses a bound by C log n; Lean follows the cited webpage in using O(log(s n)).
reformulations.equivalence_argument: The n-th squarefree integer satisfies s_n ∼ (π²/6)n. Consequently log(s_n)/log n tends to 1, so an eventual constant-multiple bound using either logarithm is equivalent. The zero-based indexing in Lean does not affect this asymptotic statement.

sources_consulted: T. F. Bloom, Erdős Problem 208, including its remarks and open status: https://www.erdosproblems.com/208, read through https://web.archive.org/web/20260903202752id_/https://www.erdosproblems.com/208.
Paul Erdős, Some unconventional problems in number theory, Mathematics Magazine 52 (1979), 67–70, especially §6 on p. 69: https://www.renyi.hu/~p_erdos/1979-22.pdf.

Current Erdős problems community database, entry 208 in data/problems.yaml, read from https://codeload.github.com/teorth/erdosproblems/tar.gz/refs/heads/main; also https://raw.githubusercontent.com/teorth/erdosproblems/main/README.md.
Local Mathlib definitions of Nat.nth, Squarefree, IsBigO, IsLittleO, Real.log and Real.rpow, and FormalConjecturesForMathlib/Data/Nat/Squarefree.lean.
